newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB doubts it can tender wheat to Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB doubts it can tender wheat to Pakistan.

text.p: Australia's record shipping programme may stop it from offering wheat into the latest Pakistan tender, the Australian Wheat Board (AWB) told Reuters on Friday.
AWB spokesman Alex Nichol said it was very possible that Australia would not be able to sell to Pakistan in its amended tender for 450,000 tonnes of U.S. and Australian wheat for delivery by April.
"It's not that we don't have the wheat or the desire (to sell) but it's a matter of getting the whole lot together," he said.
But the AWB was exploring every way possible to squeeze more wheat through Australia's logistic system, Nichol said.
In Chicago on Thursday, U.S. exporters and traders said they believed the U.S. would get the lion's share of the tender because Australia may be unable to sell more nearby wheat.
The tender is scheduled for February 16.
